## Checklist

- [ ] The behaviour is documented: the README for what an owner sees, the page of its area under `docs/`, `CONTEXT.md` for a new word, `docs/adr/` for a decision
- [ ] A schema change is a new migration, and no merged migration was edited
- [ ] A new setting is in `docs/configuration.md`, and in the chart's `values.yaml` when the chart sets it
